statement: Microsoft, Google and Meta have used capital reserves to secure long-term HBM supply contracts, keeping HBM supply concentrated at the hyperscale tier.
why: Hyperscaler long-term HBM lock-in concentrates critical GPU-memory supply among a few buyers, constraining access for smaller cloud and system builders.

impact.mechanism: Hyperscaler HBM contracts pre-allocate supply, limiting HBM (and thus GPU) availability for non-hyperscale buyers - a supply-access concentration risk.

evidence.excerpt: Microsoft, Google and Meta have used their capital reserves to secure long-term HBM supply contracts, effectively guaranteeing that supply will remain concentrated at the hyperscale tier.

confidence.basis: Secondary: TechTimes via web-search index; single-publisher for this specific claim, capped at medium.
